about:
I am a qualified and motivated Software Developer with a strong foundation in computer science and hands-on experience across the software development lifecycle. Skilled in **SQL**, **Python**, **Java**, **C#**, **ASP.NET MVC**, **Django**, **Flask**, and **web technologies**, I have contributed to projects involving **database design**, **optimization**, and **application development**.

 Currently working as an **Intern Software Developer** at **Netstar**, I’ve gained practical experience in **migrating .NET applications**, working with **RESTful APIs**, and implementing **Agile methodologies**.

 My academic background includes a **BSc Honours in Computer Science** and research in **AI-driven solutions**, reflecting my passion for leveraging technology to solve real-world problems. Outside of work, I enjoy exploring emerging technologies and continuously improving my skills through online learning. My goal is to grow into a role where I can combine my technical expertise with data-driven innovation to create impactful solutions.
